question_en: Return the top companies by resolution contribution per work item (technology leadership).

original_Korean.question: 특정 기술(Work Item)에서 회사별 Resolution 기여도는?
original_Korean.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH wi, c, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC WITH wi, collect({company: c.companyName, count: cnt})[0..5] AS topCompanies RETURN wi.workItemCode, topCompanies LIMIT 5
